gaps: Finite row/column UInt16 and CRFlags evidence does not establish whole-module/browser parity. Generic object value copy/equality, native allocation/ABI/references/dangling iterator lifetime, undefined arithmetic and invalid-index states are uncertified. Required scalar witnesses adapt erased native template arguments; output-reference tuples, independent POD entry copies and fail-fast assertion adapters retain finite numerical contracts, not native process abort. Out-of-domain changed range bit operations may not terminate; separate original diagnostics assign no successful result and no repair is introduced. Ordered-entry/valid-region and copy-progress preconditions remain required. Genuine o3tl mask operators are used in native comparison; TypeScript adapts only the original CRFlags result-mask assertion. Table/document/column/browser consumers and broader global.hxx remain unimplemented.
